note: Carroll County Conservation Board park on the SW edge of Manning around a restored 12-acre lake with a boat ramp, trail and disc golf, plus a rifle range. The campground loop sits on open ground about 100 m south of the lake, across a lawn and the park road. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $18, 16 electric/water sites, 50-amp, FCFS no reservations, showers, dump. Lakeview confirmed (loop ~80-120 m from the 12-acre lake across open lawn and the park road). Campground season not stated.
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview confirmed: the 12-acre lake (over the 5-acre pond line; the county calls it a lake) is ~80-120 m north of the campground loop across open mowed lawn with scattered trees and the park road along the shore; the lake is in open view from the loop's north end. On-water ruled out by distance and the road.
SEASON: only park hours are given ('open year round from 5:00 am - 10:30 pm'); no campground season. Left unset.
PIN OK (~65 m south of the loop centre, at its entrance). Website and phone (712) 792-4614 confirmed.
NOTE: 'Drive-in loop accommodates a 23-ft rig' dropped (not stated by the county; imagery shows a small gravel loop with RVs parked on it, no lengths posted).
